CREATE TABLE `documents` (
  `id` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `kind` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `path` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `anchor` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `symbol` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `revision` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `updated_at` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_body` (`body`) WITH PARSER ngram PARSER_PROPERTIES=(ngram_token_size=2) BLOCK_SIZE 16384
) ORGANIZATION INDEX DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC COMPRESSION = 'zstd_1.3.8' BLOCK_SIZE = 16384 TABLET_SIZE = 134217728 PCTFREE = 0
